description: Read the owner-approved product list using an exact business id or slug: categories, products, options (variants) with prices, photos, availability and whether pickup or delivery is offered. from/confirm prices are estimates. Not live stock. Use estimate_order, then request_order when the customer asks to order. sold_elsewhere products are bought on their own page (product_url), never ordered here. For one product or a long list, pass query (words in its name or description) and read more with page.next_offset.

limit.description: How many to return (default 25, at most 100)

offset.description: Skip this many matches: page.next_offset from the last answer

query.description: Words in the item's name or description, e.g. "onkyo receiver": only matching items come back

name: products
title: Read a business’s products
